payload.text: **The Molt release waits for WP05** (hv, 24 Oct 10:33Z by TUI). The scratch-tap brew install passed end to end (slot 287, 10:29-10:31Z; teardown verified by vc). The first brew Molt carries the env writer, so the tap repo, formula publish and 9c418e2 all wait for a release cut after WP05 lands. Order: cc's WP05 Molt commits, then the Molt-matts commit (env in all five armed molt.toml files, UTILZ_INSTALL_PREFIX on rhadamanth), then vc validates with dc's 0048 and pushes, then hv cuts.
